notices.when: An entry of data.results has an error, and another entry has no error
panel.fieldConfig.defaults.unit is not a unit ID of @grafana/data
notices.message: Unit <unit> is not a Grafana unit. The values show with no unit.

notices.when: The frames have more series than maxSeries
notices.message: <omitted> series with the smallest peak values are not shown.

notices.when: A refresh got the type-mismatch error, and the App drew the picked chart in its place
notices.message: The <old> chart does not fit the new data. The chart is now a <new>.

notices.when: A map layer of the geo panel needs map tiles from the network
notices.message: Map layer <name> (<type>) needs map tiles from the network. The vector basemap is drawn in its place.

notices.when: A map layer of the geo panel needs a file that is not in the Renderer
notices.message: Map layer <name>: <url> is not available offline.
